display_long_description:
VReddo LIVE is an interactive and immersive instructor-led LIVE VR training platform:
•	Connect, interact, collaborate and communicate from anywhere across the World
•	Deliver rich media – slideshows, 3D holograms, standard & 360 videos
•	Bring any topic to life – holograms & teleporting into 360 video help learners 'feel' the content

Use cases could include:
•	Orientations & site inductions
•	Remote onboarding + training of staff
•	Lectures & classrooms within Unis, Schools & RTOs

VReddo LIVE is an immersive & highly interactive way to deliver live training with superior learning retention. Simplify the most complex learning material or tasks.

VReddo LIVE is built for the Oculus platform which is designed for isolated application instances to ensure no interference or access from outside applications. Running on a secure Android operating system, VReddo LIVE recognises user data and content security is paramount, with a range of security features to ensure 100% protection
